title: feat(accessibility): implement ARIA labels and keyboard focus ring
body:
Closes #18.

This PR implements the accessibility pass as requested in issue #18:
- Added `role="navigation"` and `aria-label` to the main Sidebar navigation list.
- Added `aria-label`s to iconic buttons and sliders in the Controls strip (Play, Pause, Reset, Skip Backward, Skip Forward, Timeline, Playback Speed).
- Ensured interactive elements like the brand logo are keyboard accessible (`role="button"`, `tabIndex={0}`, `onKeyDown`).
- Added `:focus-visible` styles with a clear outline to ensure keyboard navigability for buttons, select fields, and sliders across the application.
- Verified changes visually using local Playwright tests and successfully built the frontend app.

title: checkstyle plugin config and automate with gitHub actions
body:
This PR closes issue #31 
EDIT:
1. Added apache checkstyle plugin config that adheres to **Google Checkstyle Rules** this does strict coding format check which will SONAR quality gate check
2. spotless check was added to take care of tab and indentation instead of doing it manually
3. Manually supressed certain checks in suppressions.xml file like variable names and JavaDocs as it was not strictly followed in the project.
4. Readme.md file updated with commands for checkstyle
5. added brackets to for loop and if loops that had no curly brackets to match checkstyle  rules
6. Automated format check in github flow in ci.yml file
7. A lot of files maybe shown as edited but that is purely because of reformatting indentation tabs and curly brasis. Refer [here](https://github.com/Sanan507/AlgorithmRaceVisualizer/pull/35#issuecomment-5084402868) for those files where logic was added
